headline: Chubb (CB) Could Be 4% Undervalued On Q2 2026 Earnings
summary: Chubb (CB) has drawn fresh attention after reporting second quarter 2026 results, with net income of US$2.854b and earnings per share broadly in line with the same period a year earlier. See our latest analysis for Chubb. Chubb shares have eased in the past week, with a 7 day share price return of 2.52% down.
